notes: Only CSO/SSO permittee in DC. EPA Region 3 issues the permit (DC is not NPDES-authorized), so DC Water files SSO/CSO noncompliance reports in EPA eReporting: 140 current SOBE rows 2023-03 to 2026-09. Permit effective 2018-08-26, expired August 2023, administratively continued. Website says 48 potentially active CSO outfalls; the Q2 2026 model table lists 42 active (Anacostia 11, Potomac 8, Rock Creek 23), outfalls 015-018 'consolidated to tunnel system', 006/025/026/031/037/053/057/058 separated. Northeast Boundary Tunnel, in service 2023) controls the Anacostia; Potomac River Tunnel under construction (TBMs Mary and Emily, 2025-2026); Piney Branch tunnel ground broken 2026. Also owns the Potomac Interceptor (~50 miles from Dulles through Virginia and Maryland to the Potomac Pumping Station), which collapsed on 2026-01-19 at Clara Barton Parkway, Montgomery County MD (~243 million gallons): its overflows are reported under DC0021199 although they happen in Maryland. CSO Q3 2026: 154.61 MG total (Potomac 137.83, Rock Creek 11.24, Anacostia 5.54 at CSO 010 O Street pumped overflow). ECHO DFR: https://echo.epa.gov/detailed-facility-report?fid=110029030144.
